resources.name: NWChem

access.notes: Open-source DFT code supporting B3LYP and 6-311+G(2d). Other codes with equivalent functionality (e.g., ORCA) are acceptable.

resources.notes: The tool must be able to perform spin-unrestricted geometry optimizations, harmonic frequency checks, finite-field polarizability calculations, and TD-DFT excited-state simulations.
